nom: Live Tinted Superhue Hyperpigmentation Serum Stick

segments.oily: The one reviewer who names her skin type as oily says the stick suits her well overall, though her pimples and dark spots are taking time to clear.
segments.combination: The two reviewers who identify combination skin report no irritation and no breakouts, one specifically calling it well suited to sensitive, combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report mixed results: several whose skin normally breaks out from new products say the stick is an exception that fades their marks without irritating them, while one with eczema-prone skin says it made no difference for her.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who mentions her age says she is older but that the glow the stick gives her makes her feel younger.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the stick as hydrating and moisturizing rather than drying; against that, one reviewer had an allergic reaction with dry, itchy patches across her face and neck, and another reports it causes severe dryness and painful cracking specifically where it touches her lips.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, red, textured skin reports a dramatic reduction in redness and dark marks; against that, one reviewer had a dermatologist-confirmed allergic reaction that left red, itchy patches across her face and neck.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with eczema-prone skin reports the stick made no difference and did not suit her skin, while another had an allergic reaction with dry, itchy patches; most other reviewers do not report barrier-related issues.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, acne marks, or scars, often within two to four weeks of consistent use, including reviewers with deeper skin tones or hormonal or medication-triggered pigmentation; a notable minority report zero difference even after three to four weeks of faithful, consistent use, one describing her pigmentation as too stubborn to respond.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal-acne skin report the stick fades acne marks and scars without causing new breakouts, including some who say most products break them out; two reviewers, however, report an allergic-type reaction with breakouts or hives and red, itchy, dry patches, one confirmed by a dermatologist.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers generally describe the stick as absorbing without a greasy residue once applied correctly, though a couple note it looks or feels greasy right after gliding it on until it is rubbed in and allowed to dry down; the one reviewer with oily skin says the stick suits her well overall.

aspects.libelle: Packaging fails easily: falls apart, slides, melts
Runs out faster than expected for the price
Hard to scrape remaining product from the tube
Pricey, but seen as worth it when it works

extraits.texte: This product glides on smoothly and was easily spreadable. Unfortunately, it made me break out. I had red, dry, itchy patches all over my face and on my neck. My dermatologist said I had an allergic reaction…

Ive battled a dark upper lip for so long rhinking it was hair but it was just from consistent sun exposure over the years…i also struggled with picking my face in my twenties so now im left with dark acne scars. Two days in using this product, im already starting to see my upper lip area lighten but also my acne spots fade away! I have combination skin and so far its not irritated it at all! I use it in the morning after i cleanse my face! The consistency of the product is smooth and glides on perfect. It also came in perfect condition! The tube though is kind of wonky and it feels loose when you twist the product BUT the product stays contained! Only giving it a three right now because it hasnt been used for that long yet 🙂

have been using this for my upper lip hyperpigmentation for a few weeks now and i do notice a slight difference but anytime the product accidentally touches my lips it makes them extremely dry and it causes these really painful cuts on the sides of my mouth :( obviously a strong product so i'd recommend being extremely careful!

extraits.titre: Be careful with eczema prone skin
extraits.texte: Not great but not horrible. Made no difference but as someone with eczema, it didn't work well for me.

32 y/o female with hormonal acne prone skin. Ive always had sensitive, red, textured skin. Sensitive enough that i have to run every product i purchase through three different acne ingredient checkers and this product has absolutely changed the game for me. It glides on "greasy" but once you rub it in as directed it dries fast and i have really seen such a dramatic difference in my texture, red and dark marks. 10/10

This is my first time using this stick, and it suits my skin well. After two weeks, I can see a difference in my skin. Despite having pimples and dark spots, I believe it will take some time to clear them all. Overall, it's a good purchase, though the quantity is less than expected for this price.

I have very sensitive skin and most products that I have tried make me break out, the superhue stick really works to reduce my acne scars and leaves my skin feeling more even toned. I am hooked and it's a party of my everyday skin care routine now
